store.description: Counter-Strike surf in the browser. Ride ramps, chain air-strafes and keep your speed across custom surf maps — no download, no server browser, just jump in and surf.
features: Classic CS surf movement: air-strafe, ramp glide, speed control
Custom surf maps with ramps, gaps and staged routes
Runs entirely in the window — no Steam, no download
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
